title: Eleven Minutes on a Wet Thursday
subtitle: 成功成就 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 成功成就（生活与学习·成功与成就）
meta: 主题语境：成功成就（生活与学习·成功与成就）　|　核心词汇：surprise　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 surprise 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The letter came on a Tuesday in March, and the ① surprise of it was not that she had won but that she had entered at all: she had filled in the form on a wet Thursday in November, at the kitchen table, in eleven minutes, and had told nobody, including me. She read it twice and then looked up ② in surprise, as though I had written it.

It ③ surprised everybody, which was the part the newspapers liked, and it surprised her most of all. She was sixty-one, she had never had a lesson, and the eleven people on the short list were all under thirty and all had teachers. One of them told a journalist the result had taken her completely ④ by surprise, and that she was glad for my mother, and the journalist printed that too.

In April a woman from the foundation paid us a ⑤ surprise visit, unannounced, at nine in the morning, with a photographer. ⑥ To my surprise, my mother let them both in and made tea, and afterwards she said she had known for a week and had said nothing, because the photograph would have been worse if she had been ready for it.

That the prize changed nothing ⑦ came as a surprise to the foundation, which had expected her to move to the city, take pupils and give interviews; she said the surprise of it had worn off in a week. That it changed nothing ⑧ came as no surprise to me. She went on teaching eleven children a week in the room above the shop, at the same hours, for the same money, for eleven more years.

She said once that the ⑨ surprise was not the prize but the form: eleven minutes, a wet Thursday, nobody told. Most of what happens to people, she said, is decided in eleven minutes they cannot remember. She died in 2011. The ⑩ surprise, for me, came afterwards, when I found the form in the drawer with the date on it and the tea stain, and the surprise has not worn off.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 惊讶；惊奇（情绪）
B. n. 意外的事；惊喜
C. v. 使惊讶；使感到意外
D. adj. 意外的；事先未通知的
E. 固定搭配：to one's surprise 令某人惊讶的是
F. 固定搭配：take ... by surprise 出其不意；使猝不及防
G. 固定搭配：come as a surprise（to ...）出乎（……的）意料
H. 固定搭配：come as no surprise 毫不意外；不出所料

items.q: and the surprise of it was not that
and then looked up in surprise
It surprised everybody, which was the part
had taken her completely by surprise
To my surprise, my mother let them both in
That the prize changed nothing came as a surprise
That it changed nothing came as no surprise
She said once that the surprise was not the prize
The surprise, for me, came afterwards

answers.why: the surprise 意为“意外的事”，令人意外不是她获奖，而是她竟然报名了。
in surprise 意为“惊讶地”，她读了两遍，然后惊讶地抬起头，好像信是我写的一样。
surprised 是动词，意为“使惊讶”，这件事让所有人惊讶，这正是报纸喜欢的部分。
take ... by surprise 意为“出其不意、使猝不及防”，名单上的一位说这个结果完全出乎她的意料。
surprise 作形容词，意为“意外的、事先未通知的”，基金会的一位女士事先没打招呼就来访。
to my surprise 意为“令我惊讶的是”，令我惊讶的是母亲让两个人进了门还沏了茶。
come as a surprise 意为“出乎意料”，奖项什么也没改变，这一点出乎基金会的意料。
come as no surprise 意为“毫不意外、不出所料”，奖项什么也没改变，这对我毫不意外。
the surprise 意为“意外的事”，她说意外不是那个奖，而是那张表格。
the surprise 意为“意外的事、惊喜”，对我而言，意外是在她去世之后才到来的。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 surprise 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: The surprise of it was not that she had won but that she had entered at all: eleven minutes, a wet Thursday, nobody told.
She read the letter twice and then looked up in surprise, as though I had written it.
It surprised everybody, and one of the eleven on the short list said the result had taken her completely by surprise.
To my surprise, my mother let the woman from the foundation and the photographer in and made tea for them.
